summary.en: Define six development workstreams with scopes, module ownership, validation commands and branch prefixes, and add a Track field to the pull-request template.
summary.zh: 定义六条开发工作流（范围、模块归属、验证命令、分支前缀），并在 PR 模板中增加所属工作流字段。

reason: Contributor-process documentation only. It does not change setup, entry points, advertised capabilities or user-facing behavior, so the READMEs are unchanged.

compatibility.en: No code, save, configuration or runtime behavior changes; no migration required.
compatibility.zh: 不改变代码、存档、配置或运行时行为，无需迁移。
